app.name: Chrono
app.tagline: Clients, projects, time and invoices in one place.

auth.signInLead: Chrono uses your Google account. No password to remember.
auth.failedBody: The link from Google expired or was already used. Start again.
auth.notConfigured: Google sign-in is not enabled on this Supabase project yet. Turn it on under Authentication, Providers, Google.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hoursPerDayHelp: Used to turn hours into days on day-rate projects.
settings.businessHelp: These details are copied onto an invoice when you issue it.
settings.taxProfileHelp: Decides which identifiers and legal mentions appear on your invoices.
settings.legalMentionsHelp: Printed in the invoice footer, word for word.
settings.invoicePrefixHelp: Numbers read {example}. Letters, digits and dashes only.
settings.paymentTermsHelp: Sets the due date when you create an invoice.
settings.dangerBody: This erases your clients, projects, time, leave and invoices. It cannot be undone, and accounting rules in France and Tunisia expect you to keep issued invoices for several years.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: Type {word} to confirm. Everything is erased straight away.

errors.prefixFormat: Use 1 to 12 letters, digits or dashes, such as INV or FA.
errors.hoursRange: Enter a number of hours between 1 and 24.
errors.termsRange: Enter a number of days between 0 and 365.
errors.loadFailed: This could not be loaded. Reload the page.
errors.notSignedIn: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.rateRequired: Enter an amount of 0 or more.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end date must be on or after the start date.
errors.notFound: This no longer exists. It may have been deleted.

clients.currencyHelp: New projects for this client start with it.
clients.invoiceLanguageHelp: The language their invoices are written in.
clients.archiveHelp: An archived client stays on past invoices but is hidden from the lists.
